title: Zesty Snappy Russian Kabanos Skillet
description: A tangy and snappy Russian-inspired dish featuring kabanos sausages, perfect for a brunch mood, and is dairy-free friendly. This recipe combines the flavors of Russia with a modern twist.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the chopped bell pepper and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the diced tomato and cook for 2 minutes, until they start to soften.
Add the kabanos sausages to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes on each side, until browned.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice and sodium alginate.
Using a syringe or spoon, drop small amounts of the lemon mixture into a bath of cold water to create spheres.
Add the spheres to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the skillet hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
